prompts.listening: Create ONE NEW square transparent PNG UI mascot icon for NihonGO, part of a consistent set of four head-only Momo skill icons. Reference is ONLY for the existing character identity/style, not an image to crop. Momo is the orange and cream chibi tanuki in the reference, dark chocolate round ears, cream inner ears, brown eye patches, very large warm brown eyes, tiny blush, soft polished 2D illustration. Draw a NEW distinct head pose/expression, NOT a reuse/crop of the same smiling head. Only head and requested small accessory, NO torso, paws, arms, tail or scarf. Both ears fully visible. Centered, 8% transparent padding, clean silhouette legible at 64px. No words, letters, labels, panels, circles, badges, scenery or shadows. Genuine transparent background. LISTENING icon: Momo wearing padded warm cream-and-orange headphones fitted around the head, eyes gently closed enjoying listening, small peaceful smile; ears peek out above the headband.
